correctness.rationale: For all k>=2 and n>=k+3, published pure shellability concentrates rational reduced homology in degree r-1. The signed reduced Hopf trace on invariant oriented simplices is (-1)^r times the alternating orbit-face sum. The 2026 complement classification isolates two exceptional levels. A direct binomial evaluation of unrestricted invariant faces, one central-interval correction for odd r, and exact palindromic connected-k-set counts derive all four trace cases. The eigenspace multiplicities follow from rational semisimplicity of C2. Packaged verifier passed 66 independent signed-orbit/connected-set enumerations and eight modular chain-eigenspace homology comparisons; these finite calculations corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 literature resolves Betti ranks but leaves the natural unique nontrivial automorphism action on the full two-parameter family undetermined. The closed formula identifies both rational irreducible multiplicities, with 31 versus 36 at n=10,k=5 and unbounded trace h along n=2h+4,k=2h+1. This is a motivated all-parameter representation classification, not an arbitrary finite invariant or routine restatement of the Betti number.
